My Artist Journey

My love of art began at age five, drawing Mickey Mouse alongside my grandmother, an artist herself.

After a successful career in sales, I spent over 15 years as a patent artist, developing my ability to visualize and draw objects in three dimensions.

Now in my seventies, I've returned to my artistic roots, combining the precision of patent illustration with expressive line-and-wash techniques. Inspired by masters such as Winslow Homer, I've developed a style that blends traditional methods with my own creative approach.

Today, each painting reflects a lifetime of observation, experience, and a continuing passion for art.
